_documentation: Ledger for the social-publishing pipeline (scripts/social-post.py, issue #1072). `posted` holds the dedup keys of items already published (news::<guid>, spotlight::<slug>::<isoweek>), so re-runs publish nothing. The pipeline appends here after a successful post; the spotlight key includes the ISO week so a member is posted at most once per week. Do not hand-edit unless re-publishing an item on purpose.
